title: C++: Diff Engine (LCS)
description: Implement a longest common subsequence (LCS) algorithm for text diffing.

steps.title: LCS Computation
steps.description: Write int lcs(string a, string b) that computes the longest common subsequence length. Use DP. Also reconstruct and print the LCS string. Test with 'ABCBDAB' and 'BDCABA'.
hints: If a[i-1]==b[j-1]: dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+1 else dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
Reconstruct by walking backwards through the table.
